why: Past AQI only (lags 0-6, trailing windows ending at D). AQI(D) is complete at 24:00 of D. Gaps filled causally (same-day neighbours, forward-fill <= 3 calendar days); remaining gaps use the fold-fitted climatology.
Pollutant daily means/8-h maxima and intraday shape of day D. They are inputs to AQI, but of day D, not D+1.
Valid-hour counts and raw missing flags of day D (taken BEFORE any fill); sensor gaps are informative.
AQI/PM2.5 of OTHER stations in the same (state, city) / state on day D. Their D+1 values are NOT used.
OBSERVED weather from the station's own CPCB sensors for day D; reported live, so available at issue time.

feature group / column: Weather of the target day D+1 (observed)
why: Observed future weather = leakage for a true forecast; no weather-forecast input is used.
Published ~5 days after real time, so even day-D values would not exist at 24:00 of D.

NASA FIRMS MODIS detections dated in IST from the UTC acquisition time, plus a 3-h near-real-time latency. The standard-quality-only `type` field is not used. Archive locations are the standard product (retrospective study); counts use fields that the near-real-time product also has.
Day of year/week, Diwali distance, lockdown flag of D+1: known in advance.
Coordinates, elevation, region; clim_aqi_month is fitted per fold on that fold's training rows (leave-one-year-out for training rows, so a row's own target never enters its feature).

feature group / column: AQI(D+1), AQI_cat, AQI_driver, sub-indices SI_* of D+1
why: Deterministic function of the target day's pollutant concentrations: hands the model the answer.

feature group / column: Pollutant concentrations of D+1 (PM2.5, PM10, NO2, SO2, CO, O3, NH3)
why: Inputs of the target AQI: not available when the forecast is issued.
Kept for diagnostics only, never a feature.
All windows are trailing; linear interpolation appears only as an offline reference in the imputation study.
Stuck-sensor and spike checks use only data of the same day; pressure units are decided per reading.

feature group / column: Imputer / climatology / scaler / PCA / class weights / thresholds
why: Fitted inside every fold, the final model, each backtest origin and each spatial hold-out on its own training rows.
